ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface exceeding 95% of the visible area; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to distal tips and sparse surface anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black distribution across the macro-surface. High-contrast white clusters located at coordinates corresponding to the distal tips of both lobes. Two circular ring-like low-intensity anomalies visible mid-surface on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe exhibits low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Right lobe exhibits high-frequency, high-amplitude jagged irregularities and significant terminal truncation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a standard convex-upward sweep. Right lobe sweep is geometrically interrupted, terminating in an irregular vertical boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white clusters (3-5mm pixel equivalent) concentrated at the terminal edges of both lobes. Distinct circular ring-shaped pixel disruptions on the mid-lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three unaligned, light-grey linear streaks extending diagonally across the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant truncation/missing tissue on the right lobe tip, associated with high-contrast white pixel clustering at the injury site.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique pair of nearly symmetrical circular markings (rings) present on the ventral surface of both lobes.
